about: 2005: ESRB re-rated GTA San Andreas from M to AO over hidden content unlocked by a third-party mod; Walmart, Target, Best Buy pulled it; M restored on a new version. Delta, pillar 7.

lines.text: Walmart once pulled GTA off its shelves.
lines.say: Walmart once pulled G T A off its shelves.

lines.text: It was 2005, and the game was GTA San Andreas.
lines.say: It was two thousand five, and the game was G T A San Andreas.

lines.text: A hidden adult scene was left locked on the disc, and a fan-made mod unlocked it.
So the ratings board took away its M, and made it AO: Adults Only.
lines.say: So the ratings board took away its M, and made it A O. Adults only.

lines.text: Walmart, Target and Best Buy pulled every copy.
Rockstar cut the scene, and the new version got its M back.

lines.say: G T A 6 is out November nineteenth.

lines.text: Should hidden content change a game's rating?
